definitions.inactivity: No recorded learning on at least 2 or 3 consecutive UTC calendar dates at end of day; baseline last learning date included.
definitions.added_users: Exactly 2 inactive calendar dates; nested difference between >=2 and >=3 at the same snapshot.
definitions.rank: Separate descending ranks by headcount and within-segment inactivity rate; ties use minimum rank. Not a marketing ROI ranking.
definitions.flow: Previous end-of-day stock + newly crossing threshold - relearned today = current stock. Not cumulative unique churn.
definitions.nextday: Next-day observed relearning for disjoint exactly-2 and >=3 gap groups at the same snapshot. No campaign intervention is recorded.
definitions.nextday_pooling: Date-specific estimates only; do not pool repeated user-days as independent users. March 11 next-day outcome is unavailable.
